lemma origin_cascade (d : ℕ) (e : Expression P) : M.splitting.down d (M.originProjection (d+1) e)= M.originProjection d e := by
  rw [origin_rule, map_add, map_sub,M.splitting.left,M.splitting.left]; change _+(M.originProjection d _ -M.originProjection d _)=_; rw [sub_self,add_zero]

proof_context.conclusion: `down d (originProjection (d+1) e) = originProjection d e`, i.e. `T_q P_{q+1} = P_q`.

lemma origin_grade {d w : ℕ} (h : w ≤ d) (e : Expression P) : M.splitting.part w d (M.originProjection d e)= M.splitting.top w (M.base w e) := by
  induction d,h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [M.splitting.top_part]; exact M.top_reads w e
  | succ d h ih => rw [MultipleContact.Splitting.part,dif_neg (by omega), LinearMap.comp_apply,M.origin_cascade]; exact ih

proof_context.conclusion: The projection decomposes by exact grade, `part w d (originProjection d e) = top w (base w e)`, the sum of exact-degree rows.

lemma turns_basis (s:Ortho)(b:Bool)(n:ℕ){t : S.Field n}(h:t∈M.splitting.stratum n) : M.rotation.act n s (Ribbon.glaze M b n t)∈ M.splitting.stratum n := by
   let c:M.splitting.stratum n:= ⟨t,h⟩; have he : Ribbon.glaze M b n t∈M.splitting.stratum n:=by cases b; exact h; exact (conjGrade M n c).property
   cases n; exact Submodule.mem_top
   show _∈ LinearMap.ker _; rw [LinearMap.mem_ker,← M.covariant.act, show M.splitting.down _ (Ribbon.glaze M b _ t)=0 from he,map_zero]

proof_context.conclusion: The kernel of `down` (the degree stratum) is invariant under rotations and the real structure.

lemma real_basis : Nonempty (SystemBasis M):= by
   let z: M.splitting.stratum 0:=⟨S.unit 0,Submodule.mem_top⟩
   have he:z≠0:= fun he=> S.alive 0 M.hierarchy.laws (congr_arg Subtype.val he); have hp:S.conj M.hierarchy.spin 0 (S.unit 0)=S.unit 0:=S.conj_unit ..
   obtain ⟨V,U,hz,h'⟩:=picked M 0 {z} (singleton_subset_iff.mpr (show _ from (show z∈ RealGrade M 0 from Subtype.ext hp))) ((linearIndepOn_singleton_iff ..).2 he)
   choose N B h hh using fun n:ℕ=> picked M (n+1) ∅ (by simp) (linearIndepOn_empty ..); let F (ℓ:ℕ):ℕ:= Nat.casesOn ℓ V N; let u(n:ℕ): Module.Basis (Fin (F n)) ℂ (M.splitting.stratum n) := Nat.casesOn (motive:=fun n=> Module.Basis (Fin (F n)) ℂ (M.splitting.stratum n)) n U B; -- 
   refine ⟨F,u,?_,fun n i=>?_⟩ -- Nonempty syntax?
   · obtain ⟨i,hi⟩:= hz (Set.mem_singleton z); exact ⟨i, congrArg Subtype.val hi⟩
   cases n with
   | zero=> exact congr_arg Subtype.val (h' (Set.mem_range_self i))
   | succ n=> exact congr_arg Subtype.val (hh n (Set.mem_range_self i))

proof_context.conclusion: Every stratum has a basis of conjugation-fixed vectors, with the unit in degree 0 (`SystemBasis`).

lemma project_spin (d) (x : E4) (g : Ortho) (e) : M.rotation.act d g (M.project x d e)= M.project (Ortho.move g x) d (turnExpr D R g e) := by
  change M.rotation.act d g (M.originProjection d _) = M.originProjection d _
  simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]; rw [M.origin_spin,turn_shift, ← Ortho.motion_at, map_neg]; rfl

proof_context.conclusion: The projection is covariant under rotations.

snippet.text:
lemma project_real (d) (x : E4) (e) : S.conj ρ d (M.project x d e)= M.project x d (realExpr D ρ e) := by
  change S.conj ρ d (M.originProjection d _) = M.originProjection d _; simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]; rw [M.origin_real, real_shift]

proof_context.conclusion: The projection is covariant under conjugation.

snippet.text:
lemma project_moves (d) (x u : E4) (e) : M.project (x+u) d (shiftExpr u e)= M.project x d e := by
  change M.originProjection d _ = M.originProjection d _; simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]; rw [shift_add]; congr 2; abel_nf

proof_context.conclusion: The projection at `x+u` of the shifted expression equals the projection at `x`, which is the translation covariance.
